nl.title: Postvak is vol
nl.excerpt: Mailbox of hostingquota vol: opruimen, limiet verhogen in DirectAdmin, daarna opnieuw testen.
nl.bodyHtml:
“Postvak is vol”: volle mailboxen weigeren mail. Ruim Spam/Prullenbak/grote bijlagen op of verhoog quota.

Voorbereiding

  • DirectAdmin-login
  • Welke mailbox of welk pakket vol is

Stappen

  1. DirectAdmin → E-mail Accounts: bekijk Usage vs Quota per mailbox.
  2. Webmail: leeg Spam en Prullenbak; verwijder grote bijlagen.
  3. Verhoog mailboxquota indien je pakket dat toelaat, of upgrade opslag.
  4. Bij schijfquota van het hele account: File Manager / backups opruimen.
  5. Stuur een testmail naar de mailbox.

Controleren

  • Usage onder limiet
  • Nieuwe mail komt aan

Tip: IMAP ‘Alle mail offline’ vult lokale schijf — niet altijd serverquota.

Let op: Verwijderen zonder Prullenbak legen geeft geen ruimte vrij.

Kom je er niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld je domeinnaam, wat je al hebt geprobeerd en eventuele foutmeldingen (tekst of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Backup, File Manager, upgrade.

en.title: Mailbox is full
en.excerpt: Mailbox is full: steps in webmail (Roundcube / Webmail Pro) for mailbox, full.
en.bodyHtml:
For Mailbox is full follow a targeted checklist in webmail (Roundcube / Webmail Pro). Core themes: mailbox, full.

Preparation

  • Access to webmail (Roundcube / Webmail Pro)
  • Focus of this article: mailbox, full
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Work in webmail (Roundcube / Webmail Pro). Stay on the topic mailbox, full — no parallel experiments.
  2. Sign in with the full email address and mailbox password (not the DirectAdmin password).
  3. In Roundcube/Webmail Pro open the menu for mailbox / full (Settings, Identities, Filters, Folders or Compose).
  4. Save the “Mailbox is full” adjustment in webmail.
  5. Send or receive a test message and confirm full looks correct.
  6. Document what you changed around mailbox, full (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for mailbox, full matches “Mailbox is full”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside mailbox full
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get mailbox, full right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if mailbox, full touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: webmail (Roundcube / Webmail Pro), backups, tickets.
